problems.problem: The requested vertical falloff did not execute: the hammered dimple field keeps near-uniform brightness and contrast from y=0 to y=1440, so the 'quiet dark inscription zone' behind logo/title/subtitle (y 130-377) is missing. Bright dimple rims sit directly behind the 26px logo and subtitle strokes, and the busy texture continues at full energy behind the bottle, so the niche wall never recedes and the hero separation reads weaker than in the references, whose backdrops resolve into graded light.

The concept's coarse-fine highlight dialogue is underdelivered: the frontal light leaves the black glass nearly silhouette-dark with only two small cap highlights and the label plate, while the copper wall carries all the sparkle. plaque band and niche object appear lit by different logics, unlike the references where background glow and product highlights share one light story.

The engraved铜 line decoration (#22140c, y~425) is now a near-invisible dark hairline on the shadowed copper between subtitle and cap, so the plaque band loses its closing rule and the stack floats without its base edge; the ink of the stack is resolved but the band's structure is incomplete.

changes.value: Hand-hammered copper sheet wall, dense dimple texture, extreme smooth vertical tonal gradient: near-black shadowed bronze across the entire upper half with dimple highlights almost fully extinguished there, transitioning below mid-height into a warm amber diffuse glow concentrated behind the lower center, soft metallic bounce fading toward the edges, no objects, no figures, no horizon
